note: Dimensions in mm unless a dimension carries unit. Verified means the stated nominal source was checked, not that a fabrication tolerance or material fit is guaranteed. Zero tolerance on basic/vendor nominal data is not a physical zero-tolerance specification. Unverified entries require a vendor drawing or measurement.

slas-microplate-footprint.title: Microplate footprint (base outline)

footprint_length.note: Section 4.1.1.2: overall base footprint at any point along the side. Use this band for a continuous receiving pocket. Does not specify the plate wall, lid, or draft above the base.

footprint_width.note: Section 4.1.1.2: overall base footprint at any point along the side. Use this band for a continuous receiving pocket. Does not specify the plate wall, lid, or draft above the base.

corner_radius.note: Outside radius of the four bottom-flange corners (convex). A receiving pocket's internal fillet must be no LARGER than the minimum (1.58) or it bulges into the plate corner and binds; a sharp pocket corner or a corner-relief cut always clears. Do not size the pocket fillet to the maximum radius.

footprint_length_at_corners.note: Section 4.1.1.1: only within 12.7 mm of outside corners; do not use for a continuous pocket.

footprint_width_at_corners.note: Section 4.1.1.1: only within 12.7 mm of outside corners; do not use for a continuous pocket.

slas-microplate-footprint.design_note: Continuous base pocket: size from 128.26 x 85.98 mm overall maximum envelope, then add process allowance and functional clearance. Near-corner locating pads may use the separate _at_corners dimensions. Upper plate body, draft and lid require the vendor drawing.

plate_height.note: Sections 4.1.1.1 and 4.2.1.1: resting plane to perimeter wells, not the overall bounding box. Deep-well and lidded plates require vendor dimensions.

overall_plate_height.note: Sections 4.1.1.2 and 4.2.1.2: resting plane to maximum protrusion of the plate; maximum 15.11 mm.

slas-microplate-flange.title: Microplate bottom outside flange height
slas-microplate-flange.design_note: Sections 4.1-4.3 define three uniform heights. Sections 4.4 and 4.5 also permit interrupted short flanges and dual heights. Obtain the actual flange class/profile before designing a gripper.

slas-well-positions-96.title: 96-well plate well positions

well_pitch.note: Centre-to-centre in both x and y.

a1_offset_x.note: Left outside edge to the centre of column 1.

a1_offset_y.note: Top outside edge to the centre of row A.

well_position_tolerance.note: Each well centre lies within a 0.70 mm diameter of nominal. This is a positional tolerance zone, not a +/- band.

slas-well-positions-96.design_note: Grid layout: x = a1_offset_x + 9.0 * column_index, y = a1_offset_y + 9.0 * row_index, measured from the plate outline corner.

slas-well-positions-384.title: 384-well plate well positions

well_pitch.note: Centre-to-centre in both x and y.

a1_offset_x.note: Verified directly in ANSI/SLAS 4-2004, section 4.2. Datum is the near-corner edge zones, not a bowed side midpoint.

a1_offset_y.note: Verified directly in ANSI/SLAS 4-2004, section 4.2. Datum is the near-corner edge zones, not a bowed side midpoint.

well_position_tolerance.note: Diameter of true-position zone at RFS; not a bilateral +/- band.

slas-well-positions-384.design_note: Nominal coordinates are basic dimensions; apply the radial half of well_position_tolerance plus registration and manufacturing error for a clearance gauge.

slas-well-positions-1536.title: 1536-well plate well positions

a1_offset_x.note: Verified directly in ANSI/SLAS 4-2004, section 4.3. Datum is the near-corner edge zones, not a bowed side midpoint.

a1_offset_y.note: Verified directly in ANSI/SLAS 4-2004, section 4.3. Datum is the near-corner edge zones, not a bowed side midpoint.

well_position_tolerance.note: Diameter of true-position zone at RFS; not a bilateral +/- band.

cuvette-standard-10mm.title: Standard 10 mm path-length spectrophotometer cuvette
cuvette-standard-10mm.document: Hellma 2025 cuvette catalogue: common 10 mm path-length rectangular formats; not a universal dimensional standard.

external_width.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance: illustrative nominal only; require the selected catalogue number drawing or measurement. Zero here does not mean zero manufacturing tolerance.

external_depth.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance: illustrative nominal only; require the selected catalogue number drawing or measurement. Zero here does not mean zero manufacturing tolerance.

external_height.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance: illustrative nominal only; require the selected catalogue number drawing or measurement. Zero here does not mean zero manufacturing tolerance.

path_length.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance: illustrative nominal only; require the selected catalogue number drawing or measurement. Zero here does not mean zero manufacturing tolerance.

wall_thickness.note: UNVERIFIED illustrative optical-wall thickness, not all four walls. Internal width and base thickness differ by cuvette model.

cuvette-standard-10mm.design_note: Nominal 45 x 12.5 x 12.5 mm rectangular formats exist, but no common tolerance is asserted. Fit output remains unverified; use the actual cuvette envelope including cap and optical-window height.

optical-breadboard-metric.title: Metric optical breadboard hole grid
optical-breadboard-metric.document: Thorlabs Imperial and Metric Threading: grid and thread conventions; hole and counterbore numbers below are planning examples.

grid_pitch.note: Metric grid. NOT interchangeable with the 25.4 mm imperial grid.

clearance_hole_close.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. Close-fit clearance for an M6 cap screw.

clearance_hole_normal.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. Normal-fit clearance for M6. Prefer this on printed parts.

counterbore_dia.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. For an M6 socket head cap screw head (nominal head dia 10 mm).

screw_head_height.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. M6 socket head cap screw head height (ISO 4762). A counterbore shallower than this leaves the head proud, not flush.

border.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. Typical edge-to-first-hole distance. A property of the TABLE, not of your part: your plate's edge margin is a free design choice, so do not declare this as an interface.

optical-breadboard-metric.design_note: Slot rather than hole one of any pair of mounting features to absorb grid and print tolerance.

optical-breadboard-imperial.title: Imperial optical breadboard hole grid
optical-breadboard-imperial.document: Thorlabs Imperial and Metric Threading: grid and thread conventions; hole and counterbore numbers below are planning examples.

grid_pitch.note: 1 inch exactly. Over four holes this differs from the metric grid by 1.6 mm.

thread_major_dia.note: 1/4-20 UNC: 0.25 inch major diameter, 20 threads per inch.

clearance_hole_normal.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. Normal-fit clearance for a 1/4-20 screw.

counterbore_dia.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. For a 1/4-20 socket head cap screw head.

screw_head_height.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. 1/4-20 socket head cap screw head height (0.25 inch). A counterbore shallower than this leaves the head proud, not flush.

border.note: UNVERIFIED tolerance/fit. Planning example, not a tolerance specification. Confirm the actual fastener/table drawing and process. Typical 0.5 inch edge-to-first-hole distance. A property of the TABLE, not of your part: your plate's edge margin is a free design choice, so do not declare this as an interface.

optical-breadboard-imperial.design_note: Ask which table the user has. Assuming the wrong system is the most common optomechanical design error.

cage-system-30mm.title: 30 mm cage system
cage-system-30mm.authority: Thorlabs (de facto standard, second-sourced by others)
cage-system-30mm.document: Thorlabs 30 mm cage system construction rods and cage plates

rod_spacing.note: Rod centre to rod centre, on a square pattern. 1.18 inch.

plate_thickness_typical.note: 0.35 inch, the CP33 standard cage plate. Informational, not a mating dimension: custom plates may be any thickness, but matching it keeps optical path budgets simple.

cage-system-30mm.design_note: The 30 mm rod square is centred on the optical axis. A custom plate must place its aperture at the centroid of the four rod bores. Bore diameter is rod_diameter plus twice the free-sliding per-side clearance for YOUR process (fabrication-limits.md): about 6.2 CNC, 6.4 SLA, 6.8 FDM. A 6.1 mm nominal bore is not a reliable uncalibrated printed fit; validate the actual process and rod drawing. Four bores on a common square over-constrain each other, so do not go tighter than the fits table. Declare the bore against rod_diameter with intent envelope and the clearance you chose.

sm1-lens-tube-thread.title: SM1 lens tube thread

thread_major_dia.note: 1.035 inch-40 thread. Holds 1 inch diameter optics.

sm1-lens-tube-thread.design_note: A 40 TPI thread has a 0.635 mm pitch, which is at or below the resolution of most FDM printers. Print a clearance bore and use a purchased SM1 adapter or a tapped insert rather than printing the thread.
